'''Eton mess''' is a [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] of English origin consisting of a mixture of strawberries, pieces of meringue and cream, which is traditionally served at Eton College's annual prize-giving celebration picnic on the "Fourth of June" (actually celebrated on the last Wednesday in May).<ref>{{cite web|title=Glossary C–G|url=http://www.joyofbaking.com/other/glossaryCG.html|publisher=JoyofBaking.com|accessdate=[[w:10 July|10 July]] [[w:2007|2007]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Dates of Halves|url=http://www.etoncollege.com/Eton.asp?state=load&di=171|publisher=[[w:Eton College|Eton College]]|accessdate=[[w:6 December|6 December]] [[w:2007|2007]]}} {{cite web|title=Eton Glossary|url=http://www.etoncollege.com/eton.asp?di=321#fourthofjune|publisher=[[w:Eton College|Eton College]]|accessdate=[[w:6 December|6 December]] [[w:2007|2007]]}}</ref>

== Ingredients ==
*4 medium-sized [[Cookbook:Meringue|meringues]]
*280 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (1 ⅕ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or 9 ½ [[Cookbook:Fluid Ounce|fl oz]]) [[Cookbook:Cream|double cream]]
*50 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Icing sugar|icing sugar]]
*10 ml (1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]) [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla essence]]
*150 ml (⅗ cup or 5 fl oz) Greek [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yoghurt]]
*500 g (2 ⅕ cups or 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]]

== Procedure ==
#Rinse the strawberries, remove the tops, and cut into halves.
#Break the meringues into pieces (not too small) and place into a bowl.
#Put the double cream, vanilla essence, and icing sugar into a bowl. [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] until reasonably stiff. 
#Combine the whipped cream, yoghurt, strawberries, and meringue, being careful not to mash the meringue into pieces that are too small.
#Serve in bowls.
